title: L-Innu Malti
description: Malta’s national anthem, a short prayer for the island, with words by the priest and poet Dun Karm Psaila and music by the doctor Robert Samut. It was first performed in 1923.

title: Cendrillon: Overture
description: Isouard, born in Valletta in 1773, became a popular opera composer in Paris, and his Cinderella of 1810 was one of the hits of its day. The Manoel Theatre, opened by the knights in 1732, is one of Europe’s oldest working theaters.
